### Wisdom from the Psalms 6/16
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-6-or-16-552390.html
Passage: Psalm 76:11
Points:
- People often begrudge giving offerings, incorrectly viewing donations as mere charity or church admission fees.
- True financial perspective begins with recognizing that all provision comes directly from God.
- Returning a portion of income to God is an act of gratitude rather than personal generosity.
- Faithful giving guards the heart against overvaluing temporary material possessions and points toward eternal riches.
